# Livestock Provision

Livestock provision is valued as the annual resource rent attributable to the land used in
livestock production, following the authors' write-up (`Livestock_Provision.docx`, version of
26 October 2026) and the agricultural-land framework of The Changing Wealth of Nations 2024. The
base year is 2019, in 2019 US dollars.

## Data and Methods

For country $i$,

$$
\text{GEP}_{i,2019} = \text{Revenue}_{i,2019} \times \lambda_{i,2019}
$$

where Revenue is CWoN's total livestock production revenue and $\lambda$ is CWoN's land rental
rate, land costs as a share of the total value of production. Both come from the CWoN 2024
reproducibility package (`land_pasture_revenue_total.xlsx` and `land_rental_rates.xlsx`).
Revenue is in current US dollars, hence 2019 dollars for this run. The rental rate is a
dimensionless share. CWoN builds the revenue from the products of
its Table 22: indigenous meat of ten species, whole fresh milk of five, and hides, skins, wool and
hair.

A country missing either input is missing, not zero. A zero would come only from a zero product
of two present inputs, and none occurs in 2019.

## Verification

The package also gives the rent product by product (`land_pasture_rent_cd.xlsx`). Summed by
country for 2019 it equals revenue times rate on all 189 valued countries (largest difference
$0.0000005), with the same countries missing. The run log reports this check.

The values equal the authors' own country column in the shared results sheet (largest relative
difference 5e-10, display rounding) and cover the same 189 countries. These checks reproduce
CWoN's published pasture rents. They do not validate them against independent data. The
authors' code register records validation for the earlier FAOSTAT construction: a comparison
with FAO values, done but not documented, and a comparison with non-FAO sources, outstanding.
No comparison with non-FAO livestock data has been made for the CWoN values used here.

## Feed-share diagnostic

GLEAM 3's ecosystem-provided feed share (grass and leaves, crop residues, fodder crop and
by-products over total dry-matter intake) is applied to the same CWoN revenue and written beside
the headline as `livestock_provision_gep_feed_share`. It is a diagnostic. The account's value is
revenue times rental rate.

## Coverage

The published table is one row for each of the account's 250 countries. 189 carry a value, none
is zero, and 61 are missing because CWoN has no revenue or no rental rate for them. CWoN's code
CHI (Channel Islands) has no r250 country and no value.

## Earlier construction

Until 29 October 2026 the library valued FAOSTAT gross production value over 65 livestock items
times CWoN's crop rental rate ($245.89bn over 142 countries). The authors' method uses CWoN's own
livestock revenue, and the library now follows it.
